summary: Enhance your skills with our Software Testing and Quality Assurance Training Course. Learn industry best practices and boost your career in software quality.
lede: Software testing and quality assurance give testers, analysts, and test leads a structured way to assess software and support release decisions. This training covers reviewing requirements, prioritizing test risks, designing and executing functional and API tests, and documenting defects with traceable evidence. Learners also practice selecting Selenium automation candidates and reporting quality through test results and defect trends, while advanced automation and security implementation remain overview-level topics.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who contribute to software quality, release readiness, and defect prevention across digital product teams. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who need a structured testing workflow and practical QA artefacts rather than advanced programming instruction.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Basic experience with software development, business requirements, or application support is recommended. You should be comfortable reading user stories, workflows, and simple technical documentation. No programming experience is required for completion, although basic scripting awareness helps you evaluate automation opportunities. Advanced automation, performance engineering, and security testing are introduced conceptually or operationally rather than taught at production implementation depth.
